previous_sql: SELECT p.product_category, COUNT(DISTINCT v_payment_intent.payment_intent_id) AS num_pagos_validos FROM v_payment_intent p LEFT JOIN fact_payment_attempt f ON p.payment_intent_id = f.payment_intent_id WHERE p.eventually_approved = true AND f.is_test = false GROUP BY p.product_category ORDER BY num_pagos_validos DESC
question: dame el número de pagos válidos de cada categoría de producto, ordenado de más a menos
sql: SELECT p.product_category, COUNT(DISTINCT v_payment_intent.payment_intent_id) AS num_pagos_validos FROM v_payment_intent p LEFT JOIN fact_payment_attempt f ON p.payment_intent_id = f.payment_intent_id WHERE p.eventually_approved = true AND f.is_test = false GROUP BY p.product_category ORDER BY num_pagos_validos DESC
